intuition: The most frequent value wins, with the most recently pushed value breaking ties.

brute_force.approach: Count all values and scan the complete push history to find the most frequent latest value on every pop.

optimal.approach: Track each value's frequency and keep a stack of values for each frequency level.

edge_cases: When frequencies tie, the latest value in that frequency stack is removed.
The maximum frequency decreases when its final value is popped.
